name: Bacon - Bluetooth Controller
tagline: A customizable Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) controller.
blurb: Modern Controller Design - Change button icons and sizes - Edit press and release event commands - Create multiple layout - Multi touch enabled controls GATT Support - Automaticall
description:
Modern Controller Design
- Change button icons and sizes
- Edit press and release event commands
- Create multiple layout
- Multi touch enabled controls

GATT Support
- Automatically subscribe to READ and NOTIFY characteristics
- Select different target WRITE characteristics

This is an Open Source Project, feel free to contribute to this project: https://github.com/jerameel/bacon

Supported Hardware
- Should work on majority of Bluetooth (BLE) modules and devices
- Tested working on Arduino BLE modules Ex. AT-09, MLT-BT05, HM-10
- Tested working on ESP32 modules with BLE support
